title: Localized tensor comparison: unit
statement: Let R,A,B,C be commutative rings in a universe u, A and B R-algebras, and C an algebra over E=A tensor_R B. Fix derived categories of R-, A- and B-modules, an A-complex Q, a C-complex N and a chain map t:F(Q) to N, where F is termwise extension from A to C. Let P be the all-representatives, all-models, all-degree predicate of [def-pc-localized-tensor-comparison-property]. Assume Q is K-flat over A. Given a model m of [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model] for Q, assume m.localizedComparison_i followed by H^i(t) is an isomorphism for every integer i. Then P holds for the unshifted image of the free rank-one A-module ULift A under the degree-zero single functor.

proof.text: Take S to be the monoidal unit complex A[0]. Its right unitor proves the acyclic-test K-flat hypothesis. The functor image of ULift.moduleEquiv gives an isomorphism from the specified degree-zero ULift A generator to Q_A(S). Choose a base-derived model mS for S tensor Q inside the proof.

Apply exists_baseDerivedTensorModel_quasiIso_comparison to the chain left unitor S tensor Q→Q. Let d:F(S) tensor N≅N be the scalar-extension unit isomorphism tensored with N followed by its left unitor. Whisker exchange, left-unitor naturality and Functor.Monoidal.map_leftUnitor identify (μ.inv;F(S) tensor t);d with F(λ_Q);t. Applying homology and substituting the model square makes the unit comparison followed by H(d) equal the extended model isomorphism followed by m.localizedComparison;H(t). The hypothesis and cancellation of the isomorphism H(d) prove comparison for S in every degree.

For an arbitrary K-flat representative U in the predicate, compose its supplied derived isomorphism with the ULift generator isomorphism to Q_A(S). Apply the proved representative comparison-square lemma to U,S,mU,mS in degree i. The right side is a composite of isomorphisms by the preceding step, so cancellation of the target transport isomorphism proves the requested comparison for U. All quantifiers and the original signature are unchanged.

theorem localizedTensorComparisonProperty_unit
    (hQ : ∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V Q (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
    (m : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q C)
    (h : ∀ i : ℤ, IsIso (m.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap t i)) :
    localizedTensorComparisonProperty R A B C Q N t

        (ModuleCat.of A (ULift.{0} A)))
